tldr: Pluto in the 2nd house: power becomes personal through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
body:
With Pluto in the 2nd house, this part of you intensifies money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to what you earn, keep, choose, spend, protect, and come to understand as worth your energy.

When this placement is supported, you can build a steadier relationship with what supports you. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, comfort, spending, fear, or self-protection can start making choices for you. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around money, values, security, self-worth, and what helps life feel steady.
